title: Boss: incident report
hints: README → New syntax: several awk rules in one program, `if` inside `END`, and a two-key sort.
Rule 1: split the `path=`, `status=` and `ms=` fields. Rule 2: if status ≥ 500, count it and add its ms per path. END: print paths with count ≥ 3 and total / count.

`printf 'a 4
a 6
b 1
' | awk '{n[$1]++; t[$1] += $2} END {for (k in n) if (n[k] > 1) print k, t[k] / n[k]}'` prints `a 5`.
`... END {for (k in n) if (n[k] >= 3) printf "%s %d %.1f\n", k, n[k], t[k] / n[k]}' "$DATA/app.log" | sort -k2,2nr -k1,1`.
